svg.text: F6: Helical Axis Direction Error vs Step Size
svg.title: F6: Helical Axis Direction Error vs Step Size
svg.desc: synthetic: Finite versus instantaneous helical axis error across step sizes, showing noise amplification at small angles and kinematic drift at large angles. Labelled synthetic.
svg.text: Helical axis estimation vs step size (sigma=0.001):
Moving axis error is U-shaped: noise at small steps, kinematic bias at large steps.
Woltring (1985): finite screw axis is ill-conditioned near zero rotation.
